title: ToolStarted
description: A tool invocation began. Emitted for **every** tool, including the ones no human was asked about — the audit trail is anchored on the same hook, for exactly that reason (ADR-011).

toolUseId.description: The SDK's id for this invocation. It is what ties started, progress and completed together.

input.description: The exact input the tool was called with.

title.description: A short human label for the invocation, already derived by the backend: the `description` the model gave the call (`Bash` always carries one), when it is non-blank text. Absent otherwise, and the client labels the tool as it did before.

parentToolUseId.description: Set when this comes from a subagent: the `toolUseId` of the `Task` that opened it. Absent on the main conversation.

at.description: When the entry was written, ISO 8601 — on the events of the history only, from the transcript's own `timestamp`. It marks the **end** of what the entry holds, never its start: a duration read from two of them is an upper bound. Absent live, where the frame's `ts` is the clock, and on an entry the store recorded no time for.
